Alternate supplied title: Massachusetts title collection--drawer 76
dct_description_sm: This drawer contained many views of Boston, most of which have been transferred to the Prints and Photographs Division of the Library of Congress.

This record covers single maps of Boston showing various subjects, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and may also include some multi-sheet single maps, and plates from atlases, books or periodicals. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
